claims.evidence: Avoidance of {0,4,12} forces every nonempty subset summing to zero modulo 4 to sum to 8 modulo 16, prohibiting two disjoint such subsets. An entry divisible by 4 contradicts this prohibition using the five partial sums of the other four entries in Z_4. Among the remaining residues, three or more residue-2 entries give disjoint zero-sum subsets. With two residue-2 entries, mixed odd residues give disjoint subsets, while equal odd residues force 2b=8 for b congruent to 2 modulo 4, impossible. With one or zero residue-2 entries, every surviving configuration forces 4a=8 for odd a, also impossible. The checker independently examines all C(17,5)=6188 multisets drawn from the 13 allowed residues, computes all 31 nonempty indexed subset sums for each, and asserts intersection with the forbidden set. Multisets containing a forbidden entry are blocked by a singleton. The supplied execution completed successfully.
